title: The curl-Yamabe problem
summary: We introduce and study a Yamabe-type variational problem associated with the curl operator on middle-degree forms on a closed oriented Riemannian manifold $(M^n,g)$ with $n\equiv3\pmod4$. The corresponding curl--Yamabe constant is defined by minimizing a conformally invariant, gauge-invariant quotient built from $\|{\rm curl}\,α\|_{\frac{2n}{n+1}}$ and $\int_M\langle{\rm curl}\,α,α\rangle$, and its Euler--Lagrange equation is the critical curl--Yamabe equation ${\rm curl}\,α=\frac{n+1}{2}|α|^{\frac{2}{n-1}}α$.
